doc: Caption entrance pose: fade in + de-blur. Channel value = factor × scaleBy × (a + b·e), where e is the curve value. The **evaluation order** is part of the contract: blur is written as 6.0 × canvasScale × (1 − e), multiplying by canvasScale before the parentheses; rewriting it as (6 − 6e) × canvasScale changes the pixels.
